Client workflow plugin

basecamp-dc

Projects internal delivery truth into a client-facing Basecamp view.

ROLE IN THE FACTORY

The client face

Basecamp stays understandable to the client while the engineering tracker retains the detail needed by the factory.

What it provides

A bounded capability with a clear handoff.

  • Opt-in project configuration with no PM dependency when absent
  • Separate conventions for client requests, questions, active work, and shipped work
  • Reference tokens that connect Basecamp items to internal work
  • Plain-language close-out comments and shipped summaries
  • Safety rules for Basecamp API and CLI quirks

The handoff

02PMinternal work
03Factorydelivers
04Close-outtranslates

Why it matters

One project, two useful views

The internal tracker can stay precise and machine-friendly while Basecamp remains calm and legible. The plugin translates the result at the boundary instead of forcing the client to watch the factory floor.
